```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(stats)
```

read in binned data
```{r}
x <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/histogram pimo B5 parent OE.xlsx") %>%
  rename("Bin" = "...1")

y <- x %>%
  pivot_longer(!Bin, names_to = "Group", values_to = "Intensity")
```

Remake the plot
```{r}
y %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Bin, y = Intensity, color = Group)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() + 
  theme_bw()
```

Kolmogorov-Smirnov test ??
```{r}
# Do x and y come from the same distribution?
stats::ks.test(x$Parent, x$OE)
```
